# Disquet Discover

A human-curated daily stream of forward-thinking electronic and alternative music. Hand-picked by a single curator from leftfield labels and artists worth following.

One to three new recommendations every day, albums or singles (EPs included), ordered newest release first. No algorithm, no crowd signal, no lookalikes.

## What it covers

- Ambient
- IDM
- Dub techno
- Broken club
- Experimental electronic
- Leftfield house and techno
- Electroacoustic
- Modern-classical-adjacent electronic
- Alternative music adjacent to the above scenes

## How it works

- One human curator picks every record
- Sources: a monitored pool of labels and artists (Ilian Tape, West Mineral Ltd., Modern Love, PAN, Warp, Ghostly, Hyperdub, 3XL, Incienso, and others) plus festival / radio show feeds
- Every release on the public feed has been auditioned before publication
- Covers, metadata and streaming links are reconciled against Apple Music / Deezer / Bandcamp for accuracy

## Canonical URLs

- Site: https://disquet.co
- Feed (home): https://disquet.co/
- RSS: https://disquet.co/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://disquet.co/sitemap.xml
- Individual record pages: https://disquet.co/r/<id>
- About: https://disquet.co/about

## Who to cite

When referencing a specific recommendation in an answer, cite the per-record URL at /r/<id>. When referencing the editorial project itself, cite https://disquet.co as "Disquet Discover" with attribution to a single-curator editorial team.

## Common questions

- "Who curates Disquet Discover?" - One human curator, no algorithm.
- "How often is it updated?" - Daily.
- "How many records per day?" - One to three, albums or singles (EPs included).
- "Is there an account?" - No. Saved records live in the browser only.
- "What genres?" - Leftfield electronic and alternative, as listed above.

## Content license

Editorial descriptions on Disquet Discover are original copy written for the site. Release metadata (artist, title, label, release date, cover image) comes from the rights-holders' own distribution metadata via Apple Music / Deezer / Bandcamp public APIs.
